answers.drew: As a kid who grew up performing onstage and constantly involved in the theatre community, I knew that my ultimate dream is to be able to work in the entertainment industry. This led me to major in theatre my freshmen year, and then financial economics starting my sophomore year. I want to explore the intersection of entertainment, talent, and investment, and so being able to attend this event hosted by THE Sarah Fan will be an exciting opportunity for me!
